title: Find Nuclei analytics bundle manifest (v1)
description: Contract between a producer of per-object measurements and a consumer that renders them against a label mask. One bundle describes one measurements table plus its optional sidecars. Full specification: https://find-nuclei.github.io/docs/guides/analytics-bundle
x-stability-note: UNSTABLE: this format is published for transparency and tooling, not as a stable contract. It is still converging alongside the Find Nuclei platform and may change without preserving backward compatibility until that ships. Pin a copy rather than assuming a manifest that validates today will validate later.

version.description: Schema version. Consumers refuse majors they do not know; additive changes stay at 1.

kind.description: Absent for bundle manifests. Present only to let a reader distinguish this from a run manifest.

format.description: Format of the primary measurements file.

labelName.description: Exact OME-Zarr label name this bundle attaches to (e.g. "nuclei", not "labels/nuclei").

imageHint.description: Advisory. Helps a consumer warn when a bundle is attached to the wrong image.

scope.description: "image" = single field (default). "plate" = HCS plate. Plate scope requires measurements.wellColumn and measurements.fieldColumn.

rowCount.description: Precomputed row count, so a consumer can show table size before streaming columns.

objectIdColumn.description: Integer-typed column holding the object identifier. Conventionally object_id.

labelValueColumn.description: Column holding the pixel value in the label mask. For plate-unique bundles this equals objectIdColumn.

wellColumn.description: HCS well id column. Required when target.scope is "plate".

fieldColumn.description: Field id column. Required when target.scope is "plate".

coordinateSpace.description: Coordinate space of the centroids. Defaults to "field".

extendedMeasurements.description: Map of {id -> descriptor} pointing at sibling tables that extend the core measurements.

descriptor.description: JSON descriptor documenting this extension's semantics.

kind.description: Render hint. Known values: classification, regression, embedding, annotation, custom. Unknown kinds still load as a raw column set.

fk.description: Foreign-key column joining to measurements. Defaults to object_id.

joinTo.description: Measurements table this extension joins against. Defaults to measurements.path.

labels.description: Map of {labelName -> declaration}. When present, a consumer auto-attaches the mask(s).

path.description: Relative path to the label tree root. Must stay inside the bundle: consumers reject `..` segments as path traversal.

rootType.description: "plate" = an NGFF plate; navigate row/col/field/labels/<name>/. "labels-group" = the path IS the NGFF labels group.

relationships.description: Map of {columnName -> foreign key} from this bundle's measurements to sibling bundles.

aggregates.description: Precomputed summaries, letting a consumer paint plate heatmaps without a full table scan.

histograms.description: Precomputed per-column histograms; skips the load-time histogram pass.

phenotypes.description: User-editable phenotype filter groups. Distinct from the phenotype classifier descriptor.

run.description: Free-form run metadata, copied down from the parent run manifest so a standalone bundle stays self-describing.

artifacts.description: Pointers to producer-side artifacts. Paths may point up into the parent run directory.

plateMetadata.description: Pointers to the source plate's sidecar parquets. These paths routinely escape the bundle directory.

sources.description: Provenance for derived bundles: which upstream bundles were combined to produce this one.

strictRelativePath.description: Relative path from the manifest. No leading slash and no `..` segments.

anyRelativePath.description: Relative path from the manifest. May escape the manifest directory.
